execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select activity_id, assay_chembl_id, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type, molecule_chembl_id
Join assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Join molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter assays.tid = 165
Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
Return
Sort activity_id, assay_chembl_id, molecule_chem
